assets.label: Hadley — générateur de service
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE isolated high-resolution photorealistic raster game sprite, a practical industrial colony machine inspired by the production design of Aliens (1986). This is a game adaptation, not an exact replica of an identified film prop.
Camera and geometry are essential: an elevated FRONT view with PARALLEL ORTHOGRAPHIC projection, zero yaw, zero sideways tilt, and absolutely no visible left or right side face. Front rails stay perfectly horizontal and front uprights perfectly vertical. Depth appears ONLY as the upper surface extending straight UP in the image. The back edge of the top is equal in length to its front edge; top side edges run parallel to the vertical screen axis. No trapezoid, perspective convergence or three-quarter angle. Ground contacts form one horizontal line. The whole object must fit the stated visible width-to-height ratio.
Materials: worn grey and subdued olive painted steel, bolted rectangular removable panels, practical vent slots, realistic modest scuffs and fine mechanical texture, restrained soft neutral studio lighting. Match the existing grounded, used 1980s film-set aesthetic. No modern glossy appliance, no neon, no vector artwork or cartoon.
Scene/background: genuine transparent RGBA only, with 5 percent clear margin on ALL four sides; no pixels of the object touching the canvas boundary. Full object entirely visible. Clean neutral edges: no red/yellow/white fringes, stray pixels, colored halos, floor or cast shadow outside the object. Exactly one self-contained object, one static view. No room, no wall, no pedestal separate from the object, no characters, no text, lettering, labels, emblems, logos, numbers or watermark.
Subject: a compact rectangular SERVICE GENERATOR in a squat closed industrial enclosure, not a storage cabinet or computer rack. One large circular ventilation grille centered on the front, protected by thin horizontal bars, with visible dark fan structure behind it; a narrow band of small louvres below, recessed mechanical service cover, four corner fasteners and a short integrated steel base. No CRT, screen or control desk. A thick bare rectangular top cap extends far upward in the elevated view. Any cable sockets are recessed into the front; no loose wires or pipes outside the silhouette.
Required overall silhouette width/height approximately0.73:1. Target projected geometry: width100, front body height84, visible upward top depth53.32. The top surface therefore occupies about39 percent of the total object's image height and the front occupies61 percent. Front enclosure stays square-on; the top has equal-width horizontal front and back edges.

observedLimits: Silhouette complète et face sans côté visible.
Le dessus garde une légère convergence et une profondeur visible inférieure à la consigne ; de fines franges natives subsistent autour du socle.

assets.label: Maintenance — unité de pompage
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied transparent double-pump game sprite, preserving the same single industrial machine and all its recognizable mechanical design: two round bolted pump-end housings, their short vertical pipes contained within the casing, the worn grey/olive metal, central front vent, service covers and integrated rectangular base.
Correct its physical proportions for the existing game body. The complete visible silhouette must have WIDTH / HEIGHT = approximately 0.847 (151 units wide and 178.28 units tall). The broad EMPTY TOP COVER must provide 84.28 units of projected depth, approximately 47.3 percent of the complete visible height; the front casing plus integrated base provides 94 units, approximately 52.7 percent. Deepen the top surface upward substantially while keeping the two front pump faces round and preserving their coherent spacing and bolted construction. Do not squash or stretch the circular front housings. The top is a bare cover, with only the existing ventilation slots; no control panel or additional machinery.
Camera must remain a straight elevated FRONT view with parallel orthographic projection, zero yaw, no visible left or right side face, vertical front uprights and horizontal front rails. The back and front edges of the top cover must be equal width, with depth edges running straight upward parallel to the screen's vertical axis. No converging trapezoid and no three-quarter view. Both base corners and all ground contacts sit on one horizontal line.
Clean the thin red/yellow/white fringe and stray pixels below and around the base; preserve only subdued grey/olive metal edges against true transparent RGBA. Keep at least 5 percent clear transparent margin on all four sides and show the complete silhouette. No crop, no floor, no cast shadow outside the object, no text, labels, logos, numbers, people, tools, pipes outside the casing or separate objects. Preserve the photorealistic raster texture and native transparent background. One machine, one static image.

observedLimits: Premier essai non retenu : silhouette trop large, dessus trop peu profond, frange rouge/jaune sous le socle.
Retouche sélectionnée : silhouette étroite conforme au ratio visé, grand dessus rectangulaire à bords parallèles, deux pompes frontales conservées et complètes.
Une fine frange rouge/jaune demeure sous certaines portions du socle à très fort agrandissement ; les pixels natifs ne sont pas retouchés hors imagegen.

referenceEvidence.title: Harry Harris Collection — Atmosphere Processor set dressing
referenceEvidence.observed: Coque arrière de téléviseur en plastique, peinte gris clair, reliefs étagés, rangées de fentes de ventilation, petites fixations et usure de peinture. La notice identifie un élément de décor du processeur.
referenceEvidence.use: Vocabulaire de construction pratique, panneaux gris et aérations des machines V121.
referenceEvidence.limits: Ce panneau ne prouve ni l’existence dans le film ni la silhouette des quatre objets du jeu. Les dimensions de la fiche concernent cet accessoire précis. Les machines V121 et leurs matériaux métalliques restent des adaptations ; les marquages de la référence ne sont pas reproduits.

referenceEvidence.title: Ron Cobb — concept du Medlab
referenceEvidence.observed: Vue intérieure : boîtiers et consoles rectangulaires gris-vert, panneaux vissés, aérations, écrans CRT, câbles apparents et mobilier bas.
referenceEvidence.use: Vocabulaire de matières et de construction des quatre adaptations V120.
referenceEvidence.limits: Concept de production. Ni relevé coté des meubles ciblés ni preuve de leur présence exacte dans le montage final. Les dimensions de la fiche sont celles du dessin.

referenceEvidence.title: Hadley’s Hope — collection de 80 photographies de plateau
referenceEvidence.observed: Image de vente montrant des piles de tirages et quatre photographies déployées : machinerie, loader, équipe de tournage, porte de décor ; panneaux clairs et renforts sombres visibles.
referenceEvidence.use: Contexte industriel des décors de la colonie.
referenceEvidence.limits: Seule l’image de présentation est inspectée ; les 80 vues ne sont pas toutes lisibles. Aucun des quatre nouveaux meubles n’est identifié avec certitude. Les dimensions annoncées concernent les tirages.

inspectionScope: Native PNG inspection, SHA256 and alpha measurements. Runtime contacts, occlusion, fallback and scene captures are reported separately in verification.json. The discarded initial pump remains outside the final asset pack.

integrationEvidence.reportMeaning: frozen pre-publication receipt; later CI evidence belongs to the PR and its exact commit
integrationEvidence.execution: Node/Skia, with DOM and fetch doubles; original renderer and browser fixture assertions. Only caBX provenance chunks omitted from transient decoder buffers. Source PNG pixels and bytes unchanged. This is not Chromium.
integrationEvidence.nativeLighting: Original conduit darkness outside the light cone preserved; no artificial brightening.
integrationEvidence.visualReview: Four selected source PNGs and three complete room captures inspected. All five industrial placements are complete and remain within their canvases; the valve panel rests on the visible plinth top. Original conduit darkness outside the light cone is preserved. Small native source fringes remain discreet at room scale.

conduit-valve-plinth.meaning: Visible lower front-apron edge, separate from the validated upper tabletop support contacts.
